result.description: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes meetings; offers an Enterprise Public REST API and a hosted read-only MCP server.
result.auth_detail: Public REST API: static Bearer API key generated in workspace Developer settings (no OAuth, 2 keys per user). Hosted MCP server: OAuth 2.1 with browser consent.
result.access_detail: Public API reported as Enterprise-workspace only (Developer tab absent on other plans; account manager may enable). Otter's own help pages returned 403, so gating is confirmed only via third-party Scalekit blog. MCP server works for standard Otter accounts via OAuth, no Enterprise needed.
result.api_notes: REST at api.otter.ai/v1: conversations (list/retrieve/ingest file), channels/members, audio links, workspace details, webhooks, cursor pagination, 10 req/s. MCP is read-only with 3 tools: search, fetch, get_user_info. Details from third-party sources; Otter docs unreachable.
result.blocker: Full REST API needs Enterprise workspace and static API key; the MCP path is OAuth 2.1 but read-only with only 3 tools. Otter's own docs could not be verified.

evidence.quote: The API does not support OAuth at all; it uses a static Bearer key the user generates in the dashboard.
The Public API is a REST surface at api.otter.ai/v1, available to Enterprise workspaces only.
The Public API is a REST surface at api.otter.ai/v1, available to Enterprise workspaces only.
Otter runs a provider-hosted MCP server at mcp.otter.ai/mcp.
The MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 with a browser consent step, minting a token scoped to what the user authorized.
